messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing-telemetry-desync detected in metering pipeline (token_count delta > 5% over 15m). Pager sent to billing-oncall. Grafana: <https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc?orgId=1&panelId=34>

Sam P: grabbing oncall. seeing 504s on /v1/usage/ingest in the last 10m. link to trace: <https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/xyz> :eyes:

Jess C: on it. can you dump the last reconciler job output? suspecting aggregator lag between collector -> aggregator -> billing-store.

Leo M: quick check: cluster cpu on aggregator nodes spiked at 12:04 UTC. autoscaler didn't spin up new pods fast enough. also SQS latency increased.

Sam P: copying quick sanity query to compare token sums (collector vs billing_agg):

```
-- tokens per minute last 20
SELECT minute, sum(tokens_collector) as collector_tokens, sum(tokens_agg) as agg_tokens
FROM telemetry.hourly_tokens
WHERE minute >= now() - interval '20 minutes'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute desc
LIMIT 20;
```

Jess C: run that now, posted partial results: minute=12:07 -> collector=1,270,134 ; agg=1,012,442 (20.3% delta). minute=12:08 similar. That's not transient.

Carla N: any customers hit hard? CS/finance needs a list before we start credits.

Billing-ops: pulling list from overage-flag table where flagged_at > now()-1h. quick sample: acct_3472, acct_9961, acct_2120 showing >10% spike vs baseline. Suspected false overages for a subset.

Mike L: infra note: network egress flapped briefly between az-3 and az-1 ~12:03-12:10, causing backpressure on ingest workers. SQS inflight increased.

Sam P: decision point: do we fail-open or pause overage alerts while we reconcile? I propose pause alerts (prevent automated billing charges) and enable reconciler-run in dry-run mode to backfill diff. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Jess C: +1 to pause alerts. we should NOT auto-charge while token accounting is unstable. I'll prepare a rollback plan.

Leo M: ops: can you flip alert mute on billing-overages channel and create a short-lived flag in billing-config: `suppress_overage_alerts=true` ? Also run manual reconciler: `./reconcile_tokens --from 12:00 --to now --apply` but start with `--dry-run` first.

Mike L: muting alerts now. Created flag in config service (cfg-id: cfg-9382) with ttl=1h.

Jess C: kicked off reconciler dry-run. sample output: 
```
Reconciler run (dry): window 12:00-12:30
Accounts to adjust: 1,124 total
Estimated token delta: -3,200,000 tokens (agg lower than collector)
Top 5 accounts by delta: acct_2120 ( -420k ), acct_3472 ( -310k ), acct_9961 ( -220k )
Duration: 00:04:12
```

Carla N: sharing initial impact to CS: around 1.1k accounts flagged; top 200 might have visible quota/overage notifications. Please prepare messaging: apology + we will credit any erroneous charges once reconciled.

Sam P: immediate mitigation list: 
- pause overage alerting (done)
- keep reconciler dry-run then apply if outputs stable
- scale aggregator nodes by +3 (Leo/Mike)
- throttle re-ingest bursts from collector (Jess)
- open incident page and assign severity (Sam)

Leo M: scaling aggregator now. applying replica bump +3 to deployment `billing-aggregator-prod`.

Billing-ops: exported CSV of flagged accounts and pushed to secure drive: <https://drive.redwood.internal/secure/telemetry-drift-1845923456.csv>

Jess C: after scale, re-run reconciler in apply mode with safety limits: `--max-adjust-per-acct=100k --concurrency=4`. initiating in 2m.

Sam P: paging note -> handoff protocol: I will own the incident until 13:00 UTC then hand to Jess for billing carry. Please update incident channel with status before handoff.

Incident-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026. Severity: P2. Pager history recorded. Runbook: Billing Telemetry Drift.

Mike L: aggregated CPU normalized after scale. SQS inflight reduced. latency on ingestion down to baseline in ~5m.

Jess C: reconciler apply started at 12:37. applying backfill in 5m batches. monitoring for anomalous negative deltas > 500k per account.

Carla N: drafting CS email: short note + CTA to open billing dispute. Will send once we have final reconciler summary and list of accounts with adjustments.

Sam P: update: after reconciler apply, total adjusted tokens = -3,158,920. No automated charges have been issued during suppression window. Will keep suppression until final reconciliation confirmed.

Billing-ops: confirm: we will credit any customer who was auto-charged earlier between 12:00-12:20 manually. We have 3 cases already where charges posted; flagged and queued for credit.

Leo M: recommendation for postmortem action items: 
- improve autoscaler thresholds for aggregator CPU and SQS backlog
- add synthetic token-count end-to-end check every 5m to detect divergence earlier
- make `suppress_overage_alerts` toggles auditable + accessible to oncall via Runbook UI

Sam P: agreed. I'll open the incident ticket with action items and assign owners. Tentative postmortem owner: Jess C.

Carla N: CS ask: expedite net-new billing report for affected customers with projected credit amounts. I'll coordinate with Billing-ops.

Jess C: handoff: Sam -> Jess at 13:00 UTC. Taking billing carry. will update later with final reconciler delta and list.

Sam P: thanks team. keeping channel open for any surprises. :thumbsup:

Jess C: final note (13:07): reconciler finished full-run. final summary in drive and I'll attach to INC-2026. Please route any customer escalations to `billing-ops` and cc CS.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026 updated: status -> monitoring.

Sam P: closing active paging. leaving incident open for postmortem and credits.
